about: Repositories the app suggests in its GitHub search for DDC and convolver files. Only names are listed here; the files stay in their own repositories and are fetched from there when a user picks them. kinds: vdc = DDC library, irs = convolver library.

sources.note: A large mixed collection of DDC profiles and convolver impulse responses.
About 2000 room and speaker impulse responses as .wav. Large, so pick a few rather than all.
